place.source_title: Navy Pier restaurant front under the glass arcade (1995 rebuild)

brief: A 1995 pier restaurant: a two-storey front with a big glazed barrel arch over a red-and-blue canopied terrace, lettered 'Navy Pier', tables along the dock edge, boats moored alongside. One photo. Piles carried 10 m below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: the Navy Pier entrance front (1995 rebuild) seen from the water: the great glazed barrel-vaulted Family Pavilion and Crystal Garden behind, a green-roofed red-post gateway with a big 'NAVY PIER' sign, striped awnings, café umbrellas and a blue chalet booth; fenders and ladders on the concrete dock

why.note: Venturi's decorated shed: a big glass shed fronted by a sign
